title: Reports catalog lists the 14 default reports with metadata
objective: Verify GET /reports returns the 14 default report definitions of spec §FR-021 with type key, name, description, supported filters, and required role — and only for authorized roles (DeptManager+ scoped per route table).
steps: GET /reports as manager; record the catalog.
Count + name the report types; compare against the spec's 14.
GET /reports as employee/auditor per contract (record allowed/denied).
expected_result: All 14 default report types present with accurate filter metadata; catalog visibility per role rules; any documented subset-for-role behavior is explicit, not silently missing.

title: Report totals reconcile with the permitted record set
objective: For at least 4 representative reports (asset inventory by status/category, assignment/custodian, maintenance cost, warranty expiring): verify figures reconcile exactly with independent filtered API queries, scoped per requesting user.
preconditions: Seeded data with known counts incl. finance fields; admin + dept-scoped deptmgr sessions.
test_data: GET /reports/:type for chosen types + equivalent /assets, /maintenance queries as ground truth
steps: Run each report as admin; independently compute expected aggregates via list endpoints.
Repeat one report as deptmgr; verify scope intersection (no cross-scope totals).
expected_result: Every reported total matches ground truth exactly per user scope; finance figures present only for finance-capable roles; discrepancies are defects, not rounding 'tolerances' (money is decimal).

title: Report filters and date ranges applied correctly
objective: Verify date-range and dimension filters (department, location, category, status, custodian) constrain report results with correct boundary semantics (inclusive/exclusive documented).
test_data: report query with date_from/date_to bracketing known records; dept filter; invalid date range (from > to); malformed date
steps: Run report with each filter; verify membership of boundary records.
Submit from > to and malformed dates; record error handling.
expected_result: Filtered results contain exactly the matching records with documented boundary behavior; invalid ranges → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with field_errors (no 500); empty result sets return valid empty structures, not errors.

title: Report export authorized + sanitized; opens supporting records
objective: Verify POST /reports/:type/export produces the export only for authorized roles, applies the same scope/filters/field permissions as the on-screen report, sanitizes formula-leading cells, and that report rows reference openable supporting records (asset UUIDs/links).
preconditions: A populated report; manager (finance) + deptmgr (scoped) + auditor sessions.
test_data: export request for the filtered report
steps: Export as each role; verify presence/absence of finance columns and scope of rows.
Inspect export payload for formula-injection prefixing on dangerous values.
Verify rows carry identifiers that resolve to permitted detail endpoints (or documented link format).
expected_result: Export content identical-in-scope to the report view; unauthorized export denied (403/404); sanitization per §13; supporting-record references valid and authorization-checked on use; export audited.

title: Warranty/expiry report — window buckets accurate and exportable
objective: Verify the warranty/expiry report groups assets into configured windows (expired/30/60/90 days) matching independently computed membership, and is exportable (FR-012).
preconditions: Assets spanning each warranty bucket (from TC-FR-012-01 fixtures).
test_data: warranty report default + custom window params if supported
steps: Run report; compare bucket membership/counts to ground truth.
expected_result: Buckets exact per config; expired distinct from expiring; scope-filtered; export matches; notification hooks existence documented (FR-023 linkage).

title: E2E — reports catalog and viewer UI with accessible tables
objective: UI journey: open /reports, select a report, apply filters/date range, verify rendered table matches API, open a supporting record, trigger authorized export.
steps: Open /reports; verify catalog cards/list per role.
Open a report; apply a date filter; verify loading + table update; spot-check a figure against API.
Click a supporting record link; verify asset detail opens.
Export; verify download queued/completed per async pattern.
expected_result: Viewer states complete (loading/empty/error); tables accessible (headers, captions/summary); deep links work; export follows authorized async flow. (Browser-unavailable → BLOCKED.)
